title: No test ever opens the workout plan screens
what: Workout plans, the plan builder, the ready-plan chooser, Workout of the day, Send a plan to one member and the trainer video box are checked only through their rules and the gym server. No browser test opens any of them, so not one toast, sheet, button or warning a trainer sees is checked.
expected: At least one browser test drives each of these screens like a trainer: make, send, edit, withdraw and copy a plan, set and take off a workout of the day, send one plan from a member page with Undo, add a video link.
fix_line: Add one browser test for the workout plan screens, like the diet plan one

title: The web page's Copy link and Share on WhatsApp are never tested
what: No test presses 'Copy link' or 'Share on WhatsApp' on Your web page, or checks the WhatsApp line it builds. The one-link tests check a different message on a different screen.
expected: A test presses both buttons on a published page: the toast 'Link copied.', the copied address, the WhatsApp line with the gym name and address, and no buttons when the page is not live.
fix_line: Press both share buttons in the web page browser test

title: Taking a published web page off is never tested
what: No test unticks 'Show my page to visitors' on a published page. The toast, the 'Saved, not published' status, the share buttons going away and the address staying locked are never checked on screen; only the rule that the address stays locked is checked.
expected: A test publishes, then unpublishes and publishes again, checking the status, the buttons and that the address never changes.
fix_line: Add an unpublish and republish step to the web page browser test

title: Photo location removal and the six-photo limit are never tested on screen
what: No test checks that a photo's location data is taken out before it leaves the device, and no test adds a seventh photo on screen. Only the gym server's refusal of seven photos is checked.
expected: A test sends a photo that carries a location and checks the uploaded file has none, and adds photos past six to see 'A page has at most 6 photos…' with the first six kept.
fix_line: Test a photo with location data and a seventh photo

title: The web page for a gym not online, and the desk in other states, are never tested
what: No test opens Your web page for a gym that is not online ('Your web page needs your gym online'), or as the front desk when the page is not made, saved but not published, taken down, or cannot load.
expected: A test opens the page for a gym that is not online, and the desk view in each page state and on a failed load.
fix_line: Add the not-online and desk states to the web page browser test

title: The web page preview's waiting, failure and notice words are never tested
what: The preview test checks only that the page is drawn. 'Drawing your page…', 'The preview could not be drawn…', the notice under the frame and the editor values after closing are never checked.
expected: A test checks the notice line, a failed drawing and that closing the preview keeps every typed value and the Save state.
fix_line: Check the preview notice, failure and close in the browser test

title: Saving twice from a double tap is never tested on the web page or a workout plan
what: No test taps Save twice on Your web page or on a workout plan, and none checks the 'Saving…' state, so a double save or a doubled plan would not be caught.
expected: A test double-taps Save and checks one save is sent and the button reads 'Saving…' meanwhile.
fix_line: Add a double-tap check to both save tests
